note: Hook formulas for reels. Our own 16 plus 7 adapted from ig-reel/hooks.json (Jake Schincariol, MIT, see THIRD-PARTY.md); 'from' says which. Every hook must be true to the source word for word. The examples show the shape only: they are not checked sources, so check every fact in them again before a reel uses one. Never a riddle, a scare, a guilt hook, or another page's hook line. 'trap' is how the formula gets ruined. 'match' is a loose regex that names the formula of a studied hook.

hooks.name: Direct address with a stake
hooks.from: ours (merges ig-reel #10 If This, Then Watch)
hooks.template: If you {specific situation the viewer is in}, this is for you.
hooks.example: If you feel nothing in salah, watch this.
hooks.best_for: Pulling in the exact person the reel helps.
hooks.trap: A situation so broad it names nobody. 'If you want to be a better Muslim' is not a situation.

hooks.name: Surprise fact from the source
hooks.template: {One true, strange claim straight from the text}.
hooks.example: The Qur'an says the same sentence twice, back to back.
hooks.best_for: Qur'an and hadith deep dives.
hooks.trap: A fact that is only strange because a word was left out. The full source must still say it.

hooks.name: The strongest line first
hooks.template: {The source's own sharpest sentence, in plain English}.
hooks.example: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
hooks.on_screen: NOT BEYOND WHAT YOU CAN BEAR
hooks.best_for: When the text itself is the hook.
hooks.trap: A line that is famous but flat to a stranger. Pick the sentence that would stop someone who never heard it.

hooks.name: Contrast pair
hooks.template: Not {A}. Not {B}. {What the source names instead}.
hooks.example: Not wealth. Not status. The Prophet ﷺ named something else.
hooks.best_for: Lists the source sets against each other.
hooks.trap: Contrasting with something the source never mentions.

hooks.name: A real question the source settles
hooks.template: "{A question the viewer already has, in the words people really ask it}"
hooks.example: "Does Allah still forgive me if I keep doing the same sin?"
hooks.best_for: Search, and comments from our own posts.
hooks.trap: A puzzle about who or what ('Who held the pencil?'). That is a riddle hook. Or a question tidied until nobody would type it.

hooks.name: Honest count
hooks.from: ours (merges ig-reel #11 Numbered With A Favourite)
hooks.template: {N} {things} {the source gives}. Number {k} is the one most of us skip.
hooks.example: Five things to do before Jumu'ah. Number four is the one most of us skip.
hooks.best_for: Lists, steps and sunnahs. Naming one item keeps people past item three.
hooks.trap: A count the source does not give, or N above seven. And never say 'nobody does it' about worship: say 'most of us'.

hooks.name: Result first
hooks.template: {The payoff in one line}. Here is where it comes from.
hooks.example: Two words that are heavy on the scale. Here is where it comes from.
hooks.best_for: Rewards and outcomes the text states.
hooks.trap: A payoff bigger than the text. Say exactly the reward, no more.

hooks.name: Small act, big reward
hooks.template: {A tiny act}. {The exact reward the hadith names}.
hooks.example: One sentence after wudu. All eight gates of Jannah open.
hooks.best_for: Do-along reels. Only with a sahih or hasan grading.
hooks.trap: Rounding the reward up, or using a weak hadith because the reward sounds good.

hooks.name: Scene setter
hooks.template: A man came {to the Prophet ﷺ} and asked {...}.
hooks.example: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked: which deed does Allah love most?
hooks.best_for: Narrations that show an action.
hooks.trap: Drawing the Prophet ﷺ. Show him only through light, objects or a point-of-view shot.

hooks.name: Time or place anchor
hooks.template: {After every prayer / On the night before Friday}, {what to do}.
hooks.example: After every prayer, there is one du'a you should not leave.
hooks.best_for: Instant context and a moment to use it.
hooks.trap: An 'every' or 'always' the source does not say. Absolutes are checked word for word.
hooks.match: ^\s*(?:after every|before every|on the night|every night|every morning|before fajr|after fajr|on friday)\b

hooks.name: Permission or relief
hooks.template: You do not need {the thing people think they need}. {What the source says instead}.
hooks.example: You do not need to feel holy to make du'a. You only need to ask.
hooks.best_for: Calm reels. High saves, because it removes a weight.
hooks.trap: Removing the weight and putting nothing in its place. The second half, from the source, is the whole reel.

hooks.name: Common mistake, gently
hooks.from: ours (merges ig-reel #7 Wrong Way, Right Way)
hooks.template: Most of us {do this}, and it is not our fault. {The fix from the source}.
hooks.example: Most of us read this verse alone. The verse before it changes what it means.
hooks.best_for: Teaching without a sting.
hooks.trap: 'You are doing it wrong' with no softening. That is a guilt hook and people leave.

hooks.name: Do it now
hooks.template: Pause. Say it once with me.
hooks.example: Pause. Say SubhanAllah once with me.
hooks.best_for: Do-along reels. Pairs with 'Comment done'.
hooks.trap: Asking for the act before the viewer knows why. One line of why first.

hooks.name: Loop-back line
hooks.template: {A short line that is also the last line}.
hooks.example: Two words. Heavy on the scale.
hooks.best_for: Short reels that replay.
hooks.trap: A line that only works the second time. It must hook a stranger the first time too.

hooks.name: Do you know what happened when
hooks.template: Do you know what happened when {a real event the viewer half knows}?
hooks.example: Do you know what happened when the archers left the hill at Uhud?
hooks.best_for: Seerah and Qur'an stories.
hooks.trap: Holding back so much that it turns into a riddle. Name the event; hold back only the turn.

hooks.name: In the middle of the event
hooks.template: {...the most gripping moment, already happening}.
hooks.example: The water had already split.
hooks.best_for: Stories. Starting late makes the viewer stay to catch up.
hooks.trap: Never going back. Give the setup within about 8 s, or it reads as a mistake.

hooks.name: Nobody tells you
hooks.template: Nobody tells you {a true thing about the story most people skip}.
hooks.example: Nobody tells you what Khalid ibn al-Walid did before he became Muslim.
hooks.best_for: New viewers. Seerah facts that are in the books but rarely told.
hooks.trap: A 'secret' everyone already knows. And never about a ruling or a hidden teaching: the 'untold' part must be a story detail from a checked source.

hooks.name: Someone else's story
hooks.template: There was one {man / woman / companion} who {the true turn in their life}.
hooks.example: There was one man who led the charge against the Muslims at Uhud, and later the Prophet ﷺ called him a sword of Allah.
hooks.best_for: Companions and seerah. A real person, a real change.
hooks.trap: No name and no source, which makes it a rumour. For a made-up parable, never say 'there was' as if it is true: mark it as a story.

hooks.name: Before and after, on screen
hooks.from: ig-reel #13 Before And After, On Screen
hooks.template: {Show the old state}. {Show the new state}. {One line on the one thing that changed}.
hooks.example: His heart covered in black spots. The same heart after he repented. One thing changed.
hooks.best_for: Motion reels. The cut between the two frames is the hook.
hooks.trap: Three causes. One change, from the source, or it stops being believable.

hooks.name: The objection
hooks.template: "{What people really say}." {What the source answers}.
hooks.example: "I pray, but I feel nothing." You are not the only one who has said this.
hooks.best_for: A real doubt or excuse from our comments or DMs.
hooks.trap: Inventing the objection. Take it from a real comment. And never mock it.

hooks.name: The callout, gently
hooks.template: {A specific group}, this one is for you.
hooks.example: Reverts in your first Ramadan, this one is for you.
hooks.best_for: A narrow group who will tag each other. Sends go up.
hooks.trap: A group so large it is not a callout ('Muslims'). Or a group named to shame ('people who skip fajr').

hooks.name: Cold open act
hooks.template: {The first frame is already the act happening}. Watch what this does.
hooks.example: Watch what happens to the scale when he says these two words.
hooks.best_for: Motion reels with a visible change. No setup at all.
hooks.trap: A change that takes twelve seconds to arrive. Cut to it, then show the build.

hooks.name: The checked number
hooks.template: {A number from the source} {what it counts}.
hooks.example: Seventy companions were killed at Uhud.
hooks.best_for: Sends. A number people repeat to someone else.
hooks.trap: A number from a blog or a video, not the primary text. Survey statistics about Muslims are out unless the user agrees the source.
